heroHeadline: Hungary Lifts Ukraine Accession Veto — Tivat Summit Puts Montenegro on 2028 Track
heroSubtitle: Hungary's Magyar government reached a bilateral minority rights deal with Ukraine on June 3, lifting a two-year veto and unlocking Cluster 1 accession talks for both Ukraine and Moldova — formal IGC June 15 in Luxembourg, GAC vote June 16. The EU-Western Balkans Summit in Tivat (June 5) saw von der Leyen declare Montenegro 'within reach' of 2028 membership with accession treaty drafting underway. The EP INTA committee voted 31-6-3 on June 2 to advance the EU-US Turnberry trade deal; the EP plenary ratification vote is June 16 ahead of Trump's July 4 deadline. Eurozone May inflation rose to 3.2% (highest since September 2023), cementing near-certainty of the ECB's first rate hike on June 11. The EU Migration Pact enters full application on June 12, and the 21st Russia sanctions package targeting shadow fleet and third-country circumventors is expected June 8-9.
footerNote: Data sourced from official EU institutions (EUR-Lex, European Commission, ECB, Eurostat, European Council), major outlets, and institutional analyses.
